name_en: China Merchants Steam Navigation Company Building
status: source footprint and identity frozen; architectural dimensions and facade details still require independent source evidence
anchor_method: Centroid of the exact closed OSM polygon in EPSG:3857, inverse projected to WGS84; not the tourism label node and not a bbox center.

coordinate_contract.metre_frame: Web Mercator coordinate differences multiplied by cos(anchor latitude), retaining the current city and Bund source-builder metre convention; not UTM axes.
coordinate_contract.runtime_radius_note: The source builders use R=6378137; vendored MapLibre meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits uses mean Earth radius 6371008.8. This freeze deliberately retains existing source coordinates and does not silently change model scale or the renderer.

streetfront.method: Use the long outer-ring edge whose outward normal faces the nearest saved Zhongshan East No.1 Road centreline. Keep adjacent steps and return walls; do not straighten the full polygon.
streetfront.frontage_continuity_note: Primary front edge is one original OSM segment; all original returns and setbacks remain in the footprint.

facade_frame.conversion: localENU = facade_origin + u*s + inward_v*depth; glTF position = [localE, height, -localN]. Front wall is depth=0.

identity_poi.note: Tourism label supports historical identity, not surveyed placement.

saved_map_source.note: OSM bbox endpoint alternative after Overpass errors. No inference of object absence from failed queries.

version_audit.note: Way versions differ. Identical ordered node IDs and all saved node edit timestamps older than the source way prove the retained source-way vertex coordinates. Tags are recorded separately; no version equality claim.

current_osm_overlap.measurement_crs: viewer-local Mercator metres, scaled by cos(anchor latitude)
current_osm_overlap.note: Same OSM way; version agreement or documented coordinate-continuity evidence is in source.version_audit. Saved live OSM retains original node coordinates; the city footprint came through Overture MVT and its coordinates differ. Both polygons are retained; no snapping, buffer correction or bounding-box replacement is performed.

frozen_effective_feature.appearance_accuracy: inferred module layout; no individual facade photograph
frozen_effective_feature.family_basis: source class/subtype where available, otherwise explicit height/footprint-scale inference

existing_height.note: Current source-floor-derived LoD height retained as a documented baseline only; not a measured facade or roof elevation.

parts_audit.scope: Saved source parent flag plus linked/overlapping parts in the surrounding raw owner tiles and saved OSM extract; no claim of real-world absence of roof subdivisions.

additional_overlap_candidates.name: 上海市生产服务合作联社等

replacement.mask_contract: Hide only this exact local feature ID in far geometry and omit only this source key when regenerating its shared near tile. Never hide/delete the entire near microtile: retain every sibling source key listed above.

limitations: Map footprint is a source outline, not a measured facade/laser survey.
No windows, entrances, cornice heights or roof details are established by this geometry freeze.
No existing source geometry, height, model or exclusion list has been modified.
